summary: Frontend-only retest of the Find Home map layout fixes at 390x844 on the public URL, logged in as demo@amass.africa. Six Playwright runs. Measured band: the segment ends at y=126, the count pill starts at y=714, the PreviewCard starts at y=391 (366x367). PASS: the fit after an intent change for Rent, Lease and Buy (every pin and cluster is inside the band and inside the screen edges). The Rent count is correct (8 = 4 pins + 2 + 2). Lease shows one cluster '2' at (125,507), which is acceptable. Search 'Abuja' re-fits (8, correct). Search 'Lekki' after Abuja re-fits (87 = 84+2+1). Explore wider: the pill reads 'None in view · Explore wider' after 3 zoom-ins and stays after the 4th. Tapping it shows 143 homes in view (clusters 131/8/3 plus pin ₦140M, sum 143). All of them are inside the band and the edges, with no overlaps. Cluster tap zooms in (131 splits into 106/21/2). Pin tap: the pin turns selected (brand red, scaled 98x54, not dark) and glides to (146,205), clear of the chrome and the card. Exactly one card. Close and backdrop tap both close it. No two single price pins overlap in any view. Regression: the filter sheet opens and applies; 'Search this area' appears after a manual zoom-out and disappears after tapping it; fab-locate and zoom in/out work; the tab labels are correct; all 4 tabs work and the map state is kept on return. Teaser gating: the card shows '+3 photos' with a lock, 'Terrace · Lekki · approx.' and 'Unlock · 120 MASS', with no street. FAIL/MINOR: (a) the in-view count still disagrees with what is drawn when a cluster straddles a band edge or the screen edge. (b) In All, a cluster sits 1px past the right edge because the fit is skipped. (c) Cluster circles overlap price-pin labels. (d) The Apply button in the filter sheet is off-screen until you scroll. No deprecated Expo packages were found.

ui_bugs.issue: The count is computed from each pin's own coordinate, but the map draws supercluster clusters at their centroid. This causes two mismatches. (1) After a manual fab-zoom-out from the initial All view, the pill says '11 homes in view'. Fully readable: ₦285M + ₦310M + cluster 3 + cluster 2 = 7. Cluster '13' at (112,685,52x52) has its bottom at 737, half under the pill (top 714), and only 4 of its members are counted. (2) After tapping ₦285M (the map glides) and closing the card, the pill says '3 homes in view' but only 2 pins exist in the DOM: ₦285M at (145,208) and ₦310M at (318,426,100x48). ₦310M is clipped 28px past the right edge and still counted. The third counted home belongs to a cluster whose centroid is outside the bbox, so it is not drawn. RCA: inView should count what is drawn. Sum point_count for the clusters returned by getClusters and add the singles, filtered by the drawn box (pin label [y-48,y] and x±w/2; cluster centre ±26px). Keep the band and edge checks on that box.

Rent→All and Lease→All do not re-fit, because fitToPins returns early when ANY pin's latitude is already in the band. In All, cluster-765 '2' sits at (345,458,46x46), so x+w=391 is past the 390 edge. visibleNow also ignores the 80px side margin that regionFor enforces. It should also re-fit (or pan) when the new set has pins whose drawn box is off the edges or under the chrome or pill.

Single pins never overlap each other, but clusters overlap price labels. All: cluster '20' at (46,311,52x52) overlaps pin ₦95M at (67,340,91x48) by 31x23px. Rent: cluster '2' at (247,487) overlaps ₦3.8M/yr at (251,446,119x48) by 7px. Cluster '2' at (180,492) overlaps ₦28M/yr at (97,457,113x48) by 30x13px. Cause: pins are anchored at the bottom (the label sits 48px above the coordinate) and clusters are anchored at the centre, but supercluster only measures distance between coordinates.

At 390x844 the 'apply-filters-btn' renders at y=1250, below the viewport. You must scroll the sheet to reach it, so the footer is not pinned. The ScrollView inside BottomSheetView has no flex:1, so it grows to its content height. Fix: give the ScrollView style={{flex:1}} or use BottomSheetScrollView. The Reset Pressable also has no testID.

Tapping cluster-150 (131) centres on the centroid with a square delta. One child cluster '2' lands at (141,1), under the search bar. It is correctly not counted, but it is hidden. Consider regionFor(leaves of the cluster) so the children land inside the band.

Code review: bandTop = chromeBottom/screenH + 0.04, which is y≈160. A selected pin label (54px, anchored at the bottom) whose coordinate is at y 160–180 is not moved, and its top lands 0–20px under the segment (y=126). Use (chromeBottom + 54)/screenH to match bandFracs. Not reproduced live.

ui_bugs.component: Search this area pill after Explore wider
ui_bugs.issue: After manual zoom-ins, 'Search this area' (114,138,163x39) stays visible after tapping explore-wider-pill, even though the map flew to the results. It also sits inside the top of the pin band (y 138–177), where it can cover pin labels. exploreWider could call setShowSearchArea(false).

issues: Explore-wider pin layout: cluster '8' at (284,298,46x46) has its right edge at x=330, exactly touching the FAB column (330–378). Readable, but tight.

test_report_links: Playwright scripts run inline via browser_automation (6 runs)
action_items: Make inView count what is drawn: the sum of rendered clusters' point_count plus single pins, tested against the drawn box (pin label: x±w/2 and y-48..y; cluster: centre ±26px) with the band (126..714, or the card top when it is open) and the 0..390 edges. Today the pill says 11 when only 7 are fully readable (cluster 13 is half under the pill), and 3 when only 2 are drawn (one is clipped 28px off the right edge).
In fitToPins, also re-fit when the newly visible set has a pin or cluster off the side edges (the 80px rule) or straddling the band. In All after Rent or Lease, cluster '2' sits at x 345..391.
FilterSheet: give the ScrollView flex:1 (or use BottomSheetScrollView) so the Apply footer stays pinned. Add a testID to Reset.

Optional: account for the label offset when clustering (or nudge clusters) so cluster circles don't overlap price labels; use regionFor on cluster-tap leaves; align the onMarkerPress bandTop with bandFracs (+54px); hide 'Search this area' after exploreWider.
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx is 915 lines (over 700); consider extracting the map band and fit helpers (bandFracs, regionFor, fitToPins, inView) into a hook.
inRegion checks only the coordinate; drawn labels can extend 50px past the edges or 48px above the coordinate.
The cluster-tap region uses latitudeDelta = longitudeDelta, which ignores the screen aspect that regionFor carefully keeps.

success_rate.frontend: ~82% (14/17 checks pass; count mismatch, edge clip in All, and filter-footer issues)

seed_data_creation: None. No MASS spent, nothing unlocked.

A fresh context shows the intent sheet; tap intent-all or intent-rent. The initial All view is 4 homes (₦285M plus cluster 3). rca_of_issue: Count mismatch: inView (index.tsx ~L372) filters raw pins by coordinate inside the region and the latitude band. Rendering uses supercluster.getClusters(bbox), which returns clusters by centroid, and clusters are drawn anchored at the centre (±26px). Two effects follow: (1) a cluster whose centroid is near the band edge is counted only partially, though it is half hidden; (2) a pin inside the bbox whose cluster's centroid is outside the bbox is counted but never drawn. To reproduce: All → fab-zoom-out once (pill says 11, readable 7 + a half-hidden '13'). Or tap ₦285M → close the card (pill says 3, 2 drawn). Mitigation: derive the count from the rendered clusters array, filtered by the drawn box.
